design:
Tier 1. No migration: a source's metadata file is its record, so added_by is one more key in sources/<id>.json (and its private stub).

D1 By path, read by the Hub (vault-D1). The agent names paths; the Hub reads the bytes. Text by extension (.md .markdown .txt .text .rst .vtt .srt .csv .tsv .json .yaml .yml .xml .html .htm .log, the Vault tab's own text-file list plus a few) must be UTF-8 and at most 1 MiB, as a pasted source is; .pdf .png .jpg .jpeg .gif .webp go through add_file's checks (magic bytes, 10 MiB). Anything else is refused by name.

D2 Where an agent may point (seam for reach-1019). A relative path resolves against the run's workspace (Run.workspace_dir), then the project directory when nothing is there; an absolute path must resolve inside one of those two. The allowed roots come from one function, so reach grants add roots there. The operator's API and CLI may name any path the Hub can read, except beneath AW_WORKSPACE_ROOT only in Docker mode.

D3 Bulk, per-path results. Paths and folders (recursive, hidden names skipped) expand to at most 200 files; more is a 400 before anything is written. Each file is added, skipped (same bytes as an existing source or an earlier file in the batch, by sha256 kept in the metadata; older sources are hashed on read), or refused with its reason. Never all-or-nothing.

D4 distil is required, true or false (vault-D2). With true the job's readiness is checked first (enabled, a runner, a runner that can read files when the batch holds one); a job not ready is a 409 before anything is written, naming what to do or distil=false. Then one background task distils the added sources one after another, and the answer gives the count and the paid calls: at least one per 50,000-character piece of text plus one read per PDF or image, up to one contradiction check per source more. distil=false never distils, even when the job is on. An agent's batch is autonomous work (budget-paused); the operator's is operator work.

D5 Marked, not gated (vault-D4). added_by names the agent on every source it added, listed in the map, shown in the Vault tab as 'added by <agent>'. No approval step. visibility is optional and defaults to the project's vault setting (vault-A1).

D6 CLI exception (vault-D3). `agentweave vault add PATH... --distil|--no-distil` resolves paths against its own cwd and posts them to the Hub; stdlib only.
lifecycle: When closed, this change folds into the knowledge-vault capability.
problem: Adding to the vault is operator-only and one source at a time: paste text or upload one PDF or image in the Vault tab (POST /vault/sources, POST /vault/files). The operator wants to drop a folder of files and ask an agent to ingest it (vault-1019). An agent has only vault_map, vault_read and vault_report; pasting file contents through a tool call would cost tokens and could alter the text.

requirements.rationale: vault-D1: the agent never reads or pastes the content.
requirements.statement: The bulk add MUST take file and folder paths and read each file's bytes in the Hub, applying the vault's existing checks: text by extension as UTF-8 up to 1 MiB, PDF and images by add_file's type, magic-byte and 10 MiB checks, the source type, dated and visibility checks. A file of any other extension MUST be refused naming the accepted extensions.

requirements.rationale: Partial failure must be visible, never silent.
requirements.statement: A bulk add MUST answer one result per file reached, in path order, each with status added (and the source), skipped (a duplicate, naming the source it duplicates) or refused (with the reason). A file whose bytes equal an existing source's or an earlier file's in the same call MUST be skipped. One refused file MUST NOT stop the others. A batch past 200 files MUST be refused before anything is written.

requirements.rationale: A guardrail until reach-1019 lands its grants; never the Hub's cwd.
requirements.statement: On the agent route, a relative path MUST resolve against the run's workspace, else the project directory when nothing exists there, and any path MUST resolve inside the run's workspace or the project directory (resolved through ProjectWorkspace), else be refused naming both roots. The operator's route MUST accept any absolute path the Hub can read, and in Docker mode only beneath AW_WORKSPACE_ROOT.

requirements.rationale: vault-D2: the caller states whether to distil; distillation is a paid call per source.
requirements.statement: distil MUST be a required boolean on the MCP tool, both routes and the CLI. With false nothing added MUST be distilled, even with the job on. With true, a job that is off, has no runner, or cannot read a file in the batch MUST be refused with 409 before anything is written; otherwise one call MUST queue distillation of every added source and answer how many were queued and the estimated paid calls.

A source added through the agent route MUST record added_by as the run's agent, taken from its credential and never from the body, and the map and the Vault tab MUST show it ('added by <agent>'). A source the operator added MUST have no added_by.

The bulk add MUST be reachable as the MCP tool vault_add (and its aw-tool call mode), POST /vault/paths and agentweave vault add PATH... --distil|--no-distil, whose code imports only the stdlib. visibility MUST default to the project's vault setting.

in_scope: MCP tool vault_add(paths, distil, visibility, type, dated) and its call-mode operation
added_by and sha256 in source metadata; added_by in the map
non_goals: Reach grants beyond the run workspace and project directory (reach-1019)
An approval step for agent-added sources
Extracting text from .docx or other office formats

summary: An agent, the operator's API and a new CLI command add files to the knowledge vault by naming paths (files or folders). The Hub reads each file itself, applies the vault's existing checks, and answers one result per file: added, skipped as a duplicate, or refused with the reason. Whether to distil is a required parameter; when asked, one call queues distillation for the whole batch and says how many paid model calls it will cost. A source an agent added says which agent added it, in the map and in the Vault tab.
